• Countries: Russia

  • Warnings: Technically Ы is found in Russian\Kazakh\Kyrgyz\Mongolian but not in Central European Cyrillic alphabets, but in practice it can be seen in most Cryillic speaking countries.

  • Warnings: Careful with this one, easy to confuse with Íí (which is found in other European languages) and normal stylized Ii's in certain fonts.

metas.name: Latin - Turkiye Unique Latin Letters
metas.note:
• Countries: Turkiye
  • Info: İi, while a distinct letter, can obviously be confused with other forms of i. It's quite recognisable on signs as Turkish though, so it's been included.
  • Warnings: Be careful not to confuse Şş with the Romanian Șș. Ğğ can also be found in Sami regions.
